source.quote: Property additions totaled $1,119 million for the first six months of 2026
During the second quarter 2026, the company repurchased 6 million shares at a cost of $284 million with an average price paid per share of $45.30
CSX Corporation declared a quarterly dividend of $0.14 per share, payable on Sept. 15, 2026
CSX generated $1,617 million of Free Cash Flow before dividends
